author: Chang Cheng
boundary_policy: Report all training-CV boundary selections; do not change the grid after validation. Fixed-budget evidence does not establish tuning optimality.
official_test_policy: Do not download or evaluate official test data in this development runner.

cross_dataset_decision.role: Prospective external-data check of a provisional default; CelebA development outcomes were already known.
cross_dataset_decision.eligibility: Every declared selected NMF case and all three profiles valid, converged, warning-free, and exact label/probability reproduction; no omitted unsuccessful cases.
cross_dataset_decision.weighting: Equal dataset weight; equal task weight within each dataset; equal size-seed case weight within each task.
cross_dataset_decision.accuracy_reference: Best eligible absolute-screening solver at each corresponding aggregation level.
cross_dataset_decision.primary_case_cost: Median of three serial (total fit plus joint labels/probabilities prediction) sums, using each dataset's fixed validation batch (CelebA 4000, Fashion-MNIST 2000).
cross_dataset_decision.cost_aggregation: Divide each case cost by the faster eligible solver on that same case; weighted geometric mean with the same dataset/task/case weights.
cross_dataset_decision.tie_rule: Among accuracy-qualified methods within 5% of minimum weighted cost: higher global balanced accuracy, then lower weighted cost, then CD before SPA for an exact tie.
cross_dataset_decision.no_accuracy_qualified_method: Select minimum maximum normalized global/dataset/task regret; then lower weighted cost; report the unresolved accuracy conflict prominently.
cross_dataset_decision.no_eligible_method: Do not finalize the default; retain numerical failures and diagnose separately.

sensitivities.tuning_cost: Report CV wall and aggregate compute separately; add aggregate per-job CV compute to serial deployment cost as a labeled secondary sensitivity, not the primary workload.
